question:
Identify the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the following sentence.

A __boisterous__ horse must have a rough bridle.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Calm.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"boisterous"** means noisy, energetic, and cheerful; rowdy. (उल्लासपूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example: **The children were boisterous as they played in the park.
 
 
• **"Calm" **refers to a state of being peaceful, quiet, and without worry or excitement. (शांत)
 
 
• **Example: **The calm sea made for a perfect day of sailing.
